Restructuring of 20 Point
Programme
*21 SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of STATISTICS AND
PROGRAMME IMPLEMENTATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
propose to restructure 20 Point Programme;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether the objectives of the 20
Point Programme are yet to be achieved;
and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor?
Vacant posts  in Doordarshan
*22. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that posts of
crucial decision making officers like Chief
Executive Officer, Member (Personnel),
Member (Finance) and Director-General,
Doordarshan are lying vacant for a
considerable time;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor and by
when these posts are expected to be filled
up;
(c) whether it is also a fact that vacancies
on the board are reflecting on the functioning
of Prasar Bharati;
(d) if so, whether any action plan has
been envisaged to overcome the situation; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Road development proposals from
Andhra Pradesh
*23. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received

8
any proposals  from the State of Andhra
Pradesh during the current year for up-
gradation, improvement and development
of National Highways;
(b) if so, the road-wise, National
Highway-wise details thereof; and
(c) the total funds allocated and
expenditure made by Government for the
development, up-gradation, improvement
and construction of various roads and
National Highways?
Process of poverty estimation
*24. SHRIMATI MOHSINA KIDWAI:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the entire process of poverty estimation
by the Planning Commission is
characterized by arbitrariness and gross
under estimation;
(b) whether it is a fact that there are
different agencies for devising poverty
criteria like Ministry of Rural Development
and States determining BPL status; and
(c) whether Government would fix
uniform criteria for determination and
identification of poor people for having
estimates of BPL people in the country?
Cost overrun in pending Government
projects
*25. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
STATISTICS AND PROGRAMME
IMPLEMENTATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been a cost overrun
of more than 10 per cent in 315 pending
Government projects, costing over Rs. 100
crore each;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons for not completing projects in the
estimated time, State-wise;
(c) whether his Ministry is monitoring
the projects to ensure their smooth
completion; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Indians in Pakistani jails
†* 26. DR. PRABHA THAKUR:
SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether a number of Indians are
detained in Pakistani jails, if so, the reasons
for keeping them in prisons;
(b) the approximate number thereof and
since how many years they are imprisoned;
and
(c) whether Government have taken any
action to get these prisoners released and if
so, the results thereof and if not, the reasons
therefor?
Scheme for franchising postal outlets
*27. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Department of Posts
have issued orders for the launch of the
scheme for franchising postal outlets in
urban areas in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
number of such outlets notified State-wise;
and
(c) the reasons for the franchising of
postal jobs?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

 Urban infrastructure development
schemes
*28. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of various schemes
formulated and being implemented by
Government for urban infrastructure
development in the country;
(b) the details of funds allotted for the
purpose by Government during the last
three years; and
(c) the details of achievements made so
far in this regard?
Repair and maintenance of NHs in
Himachal Pradesh
*29. SHRIMATI VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the Minister of
SHIPPING, ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the amount spent on repair and
maintenance of National Highways in the
State of Himachal Pradesh during the last
four financial years;
(b) whether it is a fact that the amount
sanctioned every financial year for repair
and maintenance of National Highways in
the State of Himachal Pradesh is inadequate
to meet the purpose;
(c) if so, whether Government propose
to sanction enough amount to maintain the
National Highways better; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Nuclear power for energy security
*30. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Planning Commission has
done any study that nuclear power is the
most cost effective means to ensure energy
security;
(b) if so, whether nuclear power is
costlier or cheaper than coal and gas based
power in Indian parameter; and
(c) the details thereof?
Roads in border areas
†*31. MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
due to hindrances from environment, forest
and various departments, road construction
work in border areas, has either stopped or
slowed down and the army have to face
many difficulties as a result thereof;
(b) if so, whether Government would
constitute any coordination committee
related to army, so that a solution could be
found sitting across the table; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor and the
steps being taken by Government to
accelerate implementation of these
projects?
Plans to provide basic amenities
*32. SHRIMATI  BRINDA KARAT:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) what are the plans of Government
to give basic amenities like cleanliness,
water, electricity and sewer lines in the 1400
unauthorised colonies in the capital city
keeping in view the forthcoming Common-
wealth Games in 2010;

(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Permanent membership in UNSC
*33. DR. NARAYAN SINGH
MANAKLAO: Will the Minister of
EXTERNAL  AFFAIRS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India is
serious about becoming a permanent
member in UN Security Council;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
aspiration to become permanent member
in Security Council does not go well with
securing UN Secretary-General's post;
(c) if so, the reasons for fielding
Mr. Shashi Tharoor for Secretary-General's
post;
(d) the extent of India's seriousness
about Tharoor's candidature and the steps
taken in mobilizing international support;
and
(e) the reasons therefor and the resultant
diplomatic fiasco?
Talks on joint anti-terror mechanism
*34. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
SHRI YASHWANT SINHA:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Prime Minister and
Pakistan's President met in Havana and
reached an agreement to have a joint anti-
terror mechanism and resumption of their
secretary level talks which were on hold
after the Mumbai blasts in July;
(b) if so, whether modalities for joint
anti-terror mechanism have been worked
out;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether secretary-level talks have
also been resumed; and
(e) if so, the outcome of the talks held?
Capacity to build nuclear weapon

SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 40 more
countries in the world have developed
capacity to build nuclear weapons;
(b) if so, facts in this regard; and
(c) the list of such countries?

Employment during Eleventh Plan
†*37. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER  be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of people targeted to be
provided employment during the Eleventh
Five Year Plan by Government;
(b) Government's plan to achieve the
target and the number of people to be
provided employment annually therefrom;
(c) whether Government would
constitute any monitoring Committee/
mechanism therefor so that implementation
of schemes is constantly monitored; and

employment annually during the Tenth Five

Stringent quality norms for operators
*38. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Telecommunication
Regulatory Authority of India has set some
stringent quality norms for operators of
broadband internet services in the country;
(b) if so, the complete details thereof;
and
(c) the details of the measures taken to
ensure prompt attending of complaint by
the operators?
Ban on late night electronic media
show
†*39. SHRI BANWARI LAL

INFORMATION AND

(a) whether the common people are
getting accustomed to sleep late due to  24
hour telecast by electronic media, resulting
in adverse effect on the health of the common
men;
(b) whether Government would
consider banning the electronic media after
11 p.m.;
(c) if so, by when; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
